verses.72:16: وَأَلَّوِ ٱسۡتَقَٰمُواْ عَلَى ٱلطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسۡقَيۡنَٰهُم مَّآءً غَدَقࣰ ا

meaning: The root غدق (gdq) describes abundance and amplitude. It refers to a plentiful life or a fruitful year. It can also describe a generous person, a wide-stepping runner, or a soft, tender youth.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic hapax root.
